guard/30921.htm.text: Guard Timos: Have you ever seen a ship approaching the dock? Isn't that a sight to behold? Just think of the distant ports it has visited! Wharf Manager Nedi could tell you more about ocean travel.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.
